title: 第14章 融合职业
slug: 次元论坛全本免费-次元论坛最新章节列表
content_zh:
“等等……立远、你怎么了？喂！别吓人啊！没听说过提炼查克拉还会走火入魔的啊！”
“怎么办……怎么办……对了！我去发帖问问！嗯？论坛怎么故障了？”
关立远此时盘坐着、一副无法动弹的样子，就在刚才他尝试着，提炼出第一缕查克拉的时候，忽然感觉全身一阵酸麻……准确的说，应该是全身的骨头一阵酸麻！
如果仅此而已的话，关立远虽然难受，但也不会太慌张，毕竟这只是一具化身，不过令他不得不在意的是，自己意识中的“骨元素使”的职业符文，也正在改变着！
至于鸣人的论坛无法连接服务器，倒是并不奇怪……
因为关立远使用了“时间调整”的插件，在时间比例调节的时候，火影世界是没有信号的！
“立远、立远！”
鸣人只看到关立远的皮肤下，好像有一只只数不清的小老鼠，正在四处窜动着，同时一阵阵骨骼摩擦的声音，从关立远的身体中传出……
就在鸣人上蹿下跳，不知道怎么办才好，不敢轻易触碰关立远，想要去找卡卡西老师，但是又不放心将关立远留在这儿，陷入无限纠结的时候，一道偏向柔和的中性声音传了过来：“没关系，是‘血继限界’在觉醒。”
鸣人吓了一跳，连忙转身看去。
只见一名穿着简易和服的“大姐姐”，正提着个篮子，似乎在采药的样子。
“诶？大姐姐你知道我朋友是这么回事？血继限界？什么东西？危险吗？”鸣人连忙问道。
居然完全没有怀疑，这位“大姐姐”是怎么悄无声息的接近这里的……
“血继限界……很危险！但不是这种危险，现在他只是正在觉醒而已，一会儿就会好了……”
“大姐姐”在说话，眼中隐约流露出了一丝“哀伤”，似乎是被关立远的“血继限界”觉醒的过程，引发了什么不好的记忆。
之后又补充了一句：“我也不是什么‘大姐姐’，我叫‘白’，是男生哦！”
“诶诶诶？男、男……明明和小樱一样可爱……”鸣人居然毫无保留的就相信了。
至少关立远还没有相信，瞧这位皮肤白皙、长发披肩、五官柔和的样子，再怎么看也不像男人！
虽然胸前没什么起伏，但是也有可能是外力的束缚，而喉咙处则是系着一根黑色的带子，看不出有没有喉结……不过这样一来，更让人有种“他”在掩饰什么的感觉。
没错，关立远现在也已经不惊慌了，虽然因为全身骨骼酸麻而动弹不了，但是已经可以理智的进行分析！

因为他也已经明白，自己身上发生了什么……
“血继限界”什么的，关立远并不是很关心，他关注的是自己的“职业符文”发生了什么！
最后还是企鹅认出了这种情况……最近一段时间，企鹅也在不断从各种渠道，吸收着主世界的知识。
【别担心，是“融合职业”！】三分钟之前，企鹅对关立远解释道。
【融合职业？什么意思？】
【一种非常罕见的现象，职业者“职业变异”的一种，通常是指一种职业、与其他相近的职业，发生了融合……】
【什么意思？“骨元素使”和什么融合了？】
【是本体系的“骨斗士”，两种职业本来就很相近，一种是操纵骨元素在体外形成攻击或者防御技能，一种是吸收骨元素来强化自己的骨骼，现在两种技能融合了……】
关立远本能的想到，这或许与“血继限界”有关！
事实也的确如此，他现在的“化身”，理论上拥有觉醒任何“血继限界”的可能性……
当然，也仅仅只是可能性，如果没有必要的“引子”，即便他经历几百集的苦情剧，也别想觉醒出“写轮眼”……
而现在正是他原本的“骨元素使”的能力，成了这必要的“引子”！
在他拥有了第一缕查克拉之后，身体中潜在的“尸骨脉”的血继限界觉醒。
同时因为规则重合的原因，又在一定程度上，将这种变异反馈给了“骨元素使”的符文，促成了“融合职业”的形成。
所以关立远现在很兴奋，感觉这次火影七日游已经值回票价了！
化身拥有什么“血继限界”只是附赠品，真正令职业符文产生的变化，却是关立远可以带主世界的！
十分钟之后，关立远身上的异状开始渐渐消退，三个“入门技能”也已经发生了改变……
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢次元论坛请大家
content_en:
"Wait a minute... Liyuan, what's wrong with you? Hey! Don't be scary! I've never heard of people who can become possessed by refining chakra!"
"What should I do...what should I do...right! I'll post and ask! Huh? Why is the forum out of order?"
Guan Liyuan was sitting cross-legged, unable to move. Just when he was trying to extract the first ray of chakra, he suddenly felt a tingling all over his body... To be precise, it should be a tingling in all the bones in his body!
If that's all, although Guan Liyuan feels uncomfortable, he won't be too panicked. After all, this is just an incarnation. But what makes him have to be concerned is that the professional runes of the "Bone Elementalist" in his consciousness are also changing!
As for Naruto's forum being unable to connect to the server, it's not surprising...
Because Guan Liyuan uses the "time adjustment" plug-in, there is no signal in Naruto World when the time ratio is adjusted!
"Liyuan, Liyuan!"
Naruto could only see that there seemed to be countless little mice running around under Guan Liyuan's skin. At the same time, waves of bones rubbing sounds came from Guan Liyuan's body...
Just when Naruto was jumping up and down, not knowing what to do, not daring to touch Guan Liyuan easily, wanting to find Kakashi-sensei, but not trusting to leave Guan Liyuan here, and falling into infinite tangles, a soft neutral voice came over: "It doesn't matter, it's the 'blood succession limit' that is awakening."
Naruto was startled and quickly turned around to look.
I saw a "big sister" wearing a simple kimono, carrying a basket, and seemed to be collecting herbs.
"Eh? Big sister, do you know what's going on with my friend? Blood successor limit? What is it? Is it dangerous?" Naruto asked quickly.
There is no doubt at all how this "big sister" approached this place quietly...
"The Blood Successor Limit... is very dangerous! But it's not this kind of danger. He is just awakening now, and he will be fine in a while..."
"Big Sister" was talking, with a hint of "sadness" in her eyes. It seemed that the awakening process of Guan Liyuan's "Blood Succession Limit" had triggered some bad memories.
Then he added: "I'm not a 'big sister' either. My name is 'Bai' and I'm a boy!"
"Eh, eh? Man, man... he's obviously as cute as Sakura..." Naruto actually believed it without any reservation.
At least Guan Liyuan didn't believe it yet. Looking at this person with fair skin, long hair, and soft facial features, he didn't look like a man at all!
Although there is no rise and fall in the chest, it may be restrained by external force, and there is a black belt tied around the throat. It is unclear whether there is an Adam's apple... But this way, it makes people feel that "he" is hiding something.
That's right, Guan Liyuan is no longer panicking. Although he can't move because of the numbness in his bones, he can analyze rationally!
Because he already understood what happened to him...
Guan Liyuan doesn't really care about "blood inheritance limits" or anything like that. What he cares about is what happens to his "professional runes"!
In the end, Penguin recognized this situation... Recently, Penguin has been absorbing the knowledge of the main world from various channels.
[Don’t worry, it’s a “fusion profession”! 】Three minutes ago, Penguin explained to Guan Liyuan.
[Integrated profession? What's the meaning? 】
[A very rare phenomenon, a type of "professional mutation" among professionals, usually refers to the fusion of one profession and other similar professions...]
【What does it mean? "Bone Elementalist" is fused with what? 】
[It is the "Bone Fighter" of this system. The two professions are very similar to each other. One is to manipulate bone elements to form attack or defense skills outside the body, and the other is to absorb bone elements to strengthen one's own bones. Now the two skills are integrated....]
Guan Liyuan instinctively thought that this might be related to the "blood inheritance limit"!
This is indeed the case. His current "incarnation" theoretically has the possibility of awakening any "blood inheritance limit"...
Of course, it is only a possibility. Without the necessary "introduction", even if he goes through hundreds of episodes of painful dramas, he will not be able to awaken the "Sharingan"...
And now it is his original "Bone Elementalist" ability that has become the necessary "introduction"!
After he possessed the first ray of chakra, the blood inheritance limit of the potential "corpse bone vein" in his body awakened.
At the same time, due to the overlap of the rules, this mutation was fed back to the runes of the "Bone Elementalist" to a certain extent, promoting the formation of the "fusion profession".
So Guan Liyuan is very excited now and feels that this seven-day tour of Naruto is worth the price of admission!
The "Blood Succession Limit" that the avatar possesses is just a bonus, but the real change in the professional runes is what Guan Liyuan can lead the world!
Ten minutes later, the abnormality on Guan Liyuan began to fade away, and the three "entry skills" had also changed...
